description: This is the main source file for the backend API of a delivery tracking application built with FastAPI. It defines various endpoints for health checks, user authentication (register, login, refresh, logout), delivery management (listing, details, status updates, location updates, history), admin functionalities (user and delivery management), and WebSocket realtime delivery updates.
